name: Saskatchewan Community Foundation Joyce Gemmell Jessen Habitat Conservation Fund
summary: Grants for projects and land acquisition or conservation that preserve Saskatchewan's native plants and wildlife, including prairie restoration and habitat preservation, for registered charities and qualified donees.

amount.note: $34,000 for projects; $70,000 for land acquisition or conservation

reporting: A Final Grant Report on progress against the proposal's goals and evaluation measures is due within twelve months of the grant being processed.

applicant_types.quote: qualified donee as defined in the Income Tax Act (Canada) or have an affiliation agreement with and a letter of endorsement of the program from a qualified done such as a registered municipality

geography.quote: The purpose of the grant is to support projects that preserve and conserve Saskatchewan's native flora and fauna.

access.quote: accepts applications for projects or land acquisition/conservation grants.

window.quote: Applications must be received by the Community Foundation on or before August 1st each year for review.

reporting.quote: Successful grantees are required to submit a Final Grant Report (using the Final Grant Report Form) within twelve (12) months of the date the grant was processed.
